overview: Membership is yearly. One plan covers you as a professional; companies, mentors and institutes have their own plans, bought for that company or profile.

rules: Prices are per year, before GST.
A plan renews only when you renew it; ICR reminds you before it ends.
A plan marked **Contact sales** is priced for you by ICR's team.
A referral counts when the person you invited joins and, for the reward, makes their first payment.

website: Plans for a company and for an institute.
